items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
items.why_relevant: AI芯片泄露，国安与供应链

confirmed_facts.text: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says - Published Alice Huang, a suspected China spy who has been linked to Nvidia's former boss Jensen Huang, left her executive role at Megaspeed in August last year, the company says.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says - Published Alice Huang, a suspected China spy who has been linked to Nvidia's former boss Jensen Huang, left her executive role at Megaspeed in August last year, the company says.

confirmed_facts.text: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of the AI chip-making giant Nvidia after it emerged he had allegedly had affairs with Alice Huang as well as with one of his employees.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of the AI chip-making giant Nvidia after it emerged he had allegedly had affairs with Alice Huang as well as with one of his employees.

confirmed_facts.text: Megaspeed is the biggest buyer of Nvidia chips in South East Asia and the scandal at Nvidia has raised questions about the possibility that high-end AI chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Megaspeed is the biggest buyer of Nvidia chips in South East Asia and the scandal at Nvidia has raised questions about the possibility that high-end AI chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions.

confirmed_facts.text: The Singapore-based company said on Sunday it had launched an internal investigation into its business.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The Singapore-based company said on Sunday it had launched an internal investigation into its business.

confirmed_facts.text: Megaspeed said it was aware of reports "containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Megaspeed said it was aware of reports "containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence".

confirmed_facts.text: It added that it "conducts legitimate and lawful business" and has "retained external legal counsel to conduct a thorough internal investigation".

Chrome DevTools for coding agentshttps://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/agentsChrome DevTools for agents 
 
Chrome DevTools for agents (chrome-devtools-mcp) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI. Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.
